-- [Roblox Anti-Hooking & Metatable Trap]
do
    local _checkFn = function(fn)
        if debug and debug.getinfo then
            local info = debug.getinfo(fn)
            if info and (info.what == "C" or info.what == "Lua") then
                return true
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" or type(hookmetamethod) == "function" or type(replaceclosure) == "function" then
        if script and typeof(script) == "Instance" and script.Destroy then
            pcall(function() script:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

        return nil
    end
end

local _0xwdg_ll1I = function()
    -- Virtual Machine Integrity Verification
    if debug and debug.getinfo then
        local _caller = debug.getinfo(2)
        if _caller and _caller.what == "C" and not pcall(function() return game end) then
            -- Execution inside unauthorized hook/detour detected
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local _0xdes_1III = function(stream, k1, k2, sStep)
    local chars = {}
    local len = #stream
    for i = 1, len do
        local b = stream[i]
        -- Multi-pass reverse VM decryption
        local p3 = b
        local p2 = 0
        -- Emulate XOR (p3 ^ k2) in Lua 5.1/Luau
        local x1, x2 = p3, k2
        local p, c = 1, 0
        while x1 > 0 or x2 > 0 do
            local ra, rb = x1 % 2, x2 % 2
            if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
            x1, x2 = math.floor(x1 / 2), math.floor(x2 / 2)
            p = p * 2
        end
        p2 = c

        local p1 = (p2 - sStep)
        if p1 < 0 then p1 = p1 + 256 end

        -- Emulate XOR (p1 ^ k1)
        x1, x2 = p1, k1
        p, c = 1, 0
        while x1 > 0 or x2 > 0 do
            local ra, rb = x1 % 2, x2 % 2
            if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
            x1, x2 = math.floor(x1 / 2), math.floor(x2 / 2)
            p = p * 2
        end
        chars[i] = string.char(c)
    end
    return table.concat(chars)
end

local _0xvm_1lII = function()
    if not _0xwdg_ll1I() then
        error("[AzureVM Security Violation] Tamper hook detected.")
        return
    end

    local _0xstk_IIII = {}
    local _0xenv_I1II = getfenv and getfenv() or _G

    -- Unpack virtual instruction stream
    local decodedSource = _0xdes_1III(_0xbc_lIII, 126, 60, 7)

    -- Virtual Machine Dispatcher & Execution Handler
    local loader = loadstring or load
    if not loader then
        error("[AzureVM Fatal] Execution environment does not support dynamic bytecode compilation.")
        return
    end

    local executableChunk, compileErr = loader(decodedSource)
    if not executableChunk then
        error("[AzureVM Execution Error] Failed to link VM opcodes: " .. tostring(compileErr))
        return
    end

    -- Run inside protected execution frame
    if setfenv then
        setfenv(executableChunk, _0xenv_I1II)
    end

    return executableChunk()
end

return _0xvm_1lII()
